story.fullStory:
John Stewart's "Gold" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Gold" is a song written and recorded by John Stewart in 1979.

It was the lead single and biggest hit among three Top 40 singles released from his LP, Bombs Away Dream Babies.

The song was Stewart's first US Top 40 hit, as well as his first chart single in a decade (since "Armstrong" which peaked at #74 in 1969).

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.
